title: LobeHub 2.3.0 turns proactive bot participation on by default
dek: Bots can initiate replies in watched channels, with owner controls and records explaining their decisions.
lede: LobeHub released version 2.3.0 on November 1 with proactive bot participation enabled by default. Bots can decide to respond to watched-channel messages without a direct mention.

body.text: The feature leaves its earlier flagged preview. A Wake records tab exposes message-level decisions and reasons. Owners can rate those judgments, giving them a way to review when the bot intervenes.

buildersNote: Before upgrading a shared workspace, test a channel containing an unanswered question, an ordinary remark and a reply addressed to another person. Compare the bot’s decisions with your team’s expectations. Assign one owner to review unwanted interventions before expanding the rollout to additional channels.

claims.text: Turning proactive participation off still allows watch-keyword wakes.

social.voiceover: [matter-of-fact] LobeHub now enables proactive bots by default in version two point three. [break] Owners can switch participation off, but watched keywords can still wake the bot in its channels.
social.short: LobeHub 2.3.0 enables proactive bots by default. Switching participation off still leaves watch-keyword wakes active.
social.long:
LobeHub released default-on proactive participation on November 1. Owners get a 30-day wake summary and individual decision records.

Test the change in a small channel before rolling it out to a team. Include messages addressed to someone else, and agree who will review interventions that interrupt a conversation.
